public_rationale: Google Cloud reported positive operating income, but that broader segment does not isolate the generative AI data centers in Zitron's argument. Microsoft's statement confirms AI revenue without quantifying it. These disclosures do not establish the claimed absence of AI-specific profit or the scale of realized generative AI revenue. Missing disclosure is not evidence of no profit, and the unspecified accounting basis also prevents a decisive money verdict.
limitations: A broad reading covering all cloud operations would materially change the assessment.
Revenue small relative to investment is an interpretation, not a threshold supplied by Zitron.
Quarterly profit, cumulative investment recovery and cash flow are distinct measures.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Big tech has not profited from AI data centers and makes little generative AI revenue.

statement.excerpt: And not to repeat the point too much, but big tech has yet to actually turn anything resembling a profit on these data centers, and isn’t making much revenue at all out of generative AI.

from_speaker: has yet to actually turn anything resembling a profit on these data centers
isn’t making much revenue at all out of generative AI
our_interpretation: Big tech means Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta.
These data centers refers to the generative AI buildout discussed immediately before the claim.
The plain reading is that this buildout has not produced positive attributable profits and that generative AI revenue remains small relative to the spending being discussed.
Profit requires attributable revenue less relevant costs, including depreciation and operating costs. Whole-company or whole-cloud profits do not establish this result.

Use April–June 2025, the latest completed quarter publicly reportable before publication, for the ongoing state. Earlier results could bear on the phrase has yet, but are context outside this target quarter.
No accounting basis is supplied for the asserted AI-specific profits or revenue. The contract therefore uses unknown and cannot receive a supported or contradicted money verdict.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable AI-specific accounts show no positive attributable profit across the named firms' generative AI data-center operations and revenue small relative to the associated expenditure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable accounts show positive attributable profit from the specified operations or generative AI revenue plainly substantial relative to associated expenditure. Cloud-wide profits or annualized revenue rates alone do not meet this condition.
